countries.finding: Read the current psychology syllabus (effective 1 February 2026) and reread 1177 guidance for ages 6–7. Teaching biological emotions, social factors and comparison of models does not adopt the precise causal rankings for national IQ, general interests or immediate moral intuitions. Checked the Defence University perspective of 8 March 2022, the 2010 inquiry manual and FIB 2019:1. Academic discussion and an inquiry proposal do not establish adoption of an anticipatory-force rule; FIB sets training requirements without adopting that rule. The indexed IKFN 2016 PDF failed retrieval (404), so its text/current status was not verified. Tactical or personal self-defence cannot automatically settle state anticipatory self-defence.

countries.finding: Read the accessible PDF of Genomics Beyond Health, including its education discussion (pp.134–141); it explicitly states that it is not government policy. It concerns individual cognitive/educational traits, not national IQ or general interests. Targeted official-source searches located empathy genetics research and prosecutorial brain-maturation guidance, without establishing adoption of the required comparative explanation. Maturation is not inherited variation. Equality obligations and sex verification do not rank causes of general male–female behaviour. No adopted ranking for immediate moral intuition was located. The early-years HTML source was intermittently unavailable and no successful complete reread is claimed.
